python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import pathlib
ROOT = pathlib.Path('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p = ROOT / 'src/ir_lower/function.rs'
t = p.read_text()
n = t.count('        &check_result.string_incdec_locals,\n')
t = t.replace('        &check_result.string_incdec_locals,\n',
              '        &check_result.string_incdec_locals,\n        &check_result.widened_scalar_locals,\n')
t = t.replace('        parent.string_incdec_locals,\n',
              '        parent.string_incdec_locals,\n        parent.widened_scalar_locals,\n')
t = t.replace('    string_incdec_locals: &std::collections::HashSet<(String, String)>,\n',
              '    string_incdec_locals: &std::collections::HashSet<(String, String)>,\n'
              '    widened_scalar_locals: &std::collections::HashSet<(String, String)>,\n')
t = t.replace('        string_incdec_locals,\n        loop_storage_scope,',
              '        string_incdec_locals,\n        widened_scalar_locals,\n        loop_storage_scope,')
p.write_text(t)
print(f'threaded through {n} call sites plus the nested-context path')
